rubrics.justification: Mostly consistent with the reported 4AA and appropriately cautious about limits of a single static image, but it overstates confidence in visible ICM/TE detail and hatching status from this off-plane image.
Thoroughly integrates age, ovarian reserve/response, BMI, male factor context, endometrial thickness, prior IVF history, and lifestyle factors with embryo quality and prognosis.
Reasoning is logical and internally consistent, with appropriate caveats about morphology versus euploidy and prior failure; only minor overreach in linking image appearance to top-tier grading.
Recommendations are broadly evidence-based and consistent with standard IVF practice, including caution against routine add-on therapies and selective rather than routine PGT-A at age 32.
Provides practical next steps for transfer optimization and sensible future workup if unsuccessful, though some recommendations remain somewhat general rather than highly protocol-specific.
